Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add theme-aware vector icons to AvalonDock context menus and fix floating window UX

- Add 11 vector icons \(Canvas/Path pattern\) to IconDictionary.xaml with DynamicResource
  theme brushes for Light, Dark, and Blue VS2013 themes
- Add 3 ComponentResourceKeys \(Halo, Foreground, ContentFill\) to ResourceKeys.cs
  and corresponding brush entries in all three theme files
- Update both context menus in VS2013 Generic.xaml with ContentControl icon references
- Delete obsolete HTabGroup.png and VTabGroup.png

Fix context menu placement on floating windows:
- Use PlacementMode.Absolute with Win32 GetCursorPos for reliable positioning
  from WM_NCRBUTTONUP \(WPF Mouse.GetPosition is unreliable in non-client area\)
- Reset HorizontalOffset/VerticalOffset in DropDownButton and DropDownControlArea
  to prevent stale absolute coordinates from floating windows carrying over
- Set PlacementTarget to Content element for DynamicResource icon resolution

Fix floating window flash-of-empty-window on creation:
- Cloak window via DwmSetWindowAttribute\(DWMWA_CLOAK\) in SourceInitialized
- Uncloak in ContentRendered after WPF content is fully rendered
- Add CloakWindow/UncloakWindow helpers to Win32Helper

Fix menu labels:
- "Document CloseAll" → "Close All" \(use resource string instead of hardcoded\)
- "Dock as Tabbed Document" → "Dock as Tabbed Window" \(Resources.resx\)
- "Close All Documents" → "Close All" \(FrameworkUI MainWindow Windows menu\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(/tmp/fix_axes.ps1 << 'PSEOF'
$file = 'C:\\GIT\\wpf-framework\\src\\OxyPlotControls\\Axes\\AxesControl.xaml.cs'
$content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText\($file\)

# Normalize line endings
$content = $content -replace "`r`n", "`n"

# 1. Remove _suppressPlotChanged field and doc comment
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "        /// <summary>`n        /// Flag to suppress PlotChanged events during initialization or programmatic updates.`n        /// </summary>`n        private bool _suppressPlotChanged = true;`n`n",
    ""\)

# 2. Remove _subscribedAxisControl field and doc comment
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "        /// <summary>`n        /// Reference to the currently subscribed AxisControl for PlotChanged event management.`n        /// </summary>`n        private AxisControl? _subscribedAxisControl;`n",
    ""\)

# 3. Remove PlotChanged event and doc comment \(inside #region Events\)
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "        #region Events`n`n        /// <summary>`n        /// Occurs when any axis property has been modified through user interaction.`n        /// </summary>`n        /// <remarks>`n        /// This event is raised when the child AxisControl's PlotChanged event fires,`n        /// bubbling up property changes from the currently selected axis.`n        /// Subscribe to this event to track unsaved changes and update dirty state.`n        /// The event is suppressed during control initialization.`n        /// </remarks>`n        public event EventHandler? PlotChanged;`n`n        #endregion`n",
    ""\)

# 4. Remove Loaded += line in constructor
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "`n            // Enable PlotChanged events after control is fully loaded`n            Loaded += \(s, e\) => _suppressPlotChanged = false;`n",
    ""\)

# 5. Remove SubscribeToAxisControl call in constructor
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "`n            // Subscribe to child AxisControl's PlotChanged event`n            SubscribeToAxisControl\(AxisPropertiesControl\);`n",
    ""\)

# 6. Remove OnPlotChanged method \(#region Protected Methods\)
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "        #region Protected Methods`n`n        /// <summary>`n        /// Raises the <see cref=""PlotChanged""/> event if not suppressed.`n        /// </summary>`n        protected virtual void OnPlotChanged\(\)`n        {`n            if \(!_suppressPlotChanged\)`n            {`n                PlotChanged?.Invoke\(this, EventArgs.Empty\);`n            }`n        }`n`n        #endregion`n",
    ""\)

# 7. Remove SubscribeToAxisControl method
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "        /// <summary>`n        /// Subscribes to a new AxisControl's PlotChanged event and unsubscribes from any previously subscribed control.`n        /// </summary>`n        /// <param name=""axisControl"">The AxisControl to subscribe to.</param>`n        private void SubscribeToAxisControl\(AxisControl? axisControl\)`n        {`n            // Unsubscribe from the old AxisControl if we were subscribed`n            if \(_subscribedAxisControl != null\)`n            {`n                _subscribedAxisControl.PlotChanged -= AxisPropertiesControl_PlotChanged;`n            }`n`n            // Subscribe to the new AxisControl`n            _subscribedAxisControl = axisControl;`n            if \(_subscribedAxisControl != null\)`n            {`n                _subscribedAxisControl.PlotChanged += AxisPropertiesControl_PlotChanged;`n            }`n        }`n`n",
    ""\)

# 8. Remove AxisPropertiesControl_PlotChanged handler
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "        /// <summary>`n        /// Handles the PlotChanged event from the child AxisControl and bubbles it up.`n        /// </summary>`n        /// <param name=""sender"">The source of the event.</param>`n        /// <param name=""e"">The event arguments.</param>`n        private void AxisPropertiesControl_PlotChanged\(object? sender, EventArgs e\)`n        {`n            OnPlotChanged\(\);`n        }`n`n",
    ""\)

# 9. Remove AxesControl_Unloaded handler \(it only unsubscribes from PlotChanged\)
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "        /// <summary>`n        /// Handles the Unloaded event to clean up event subscriptions.`n        /// </summary>`n        /// <param name=""sender"">The source of the event.</param>`n        /// <param name=""e"">The event arguments.</param>`n        private void AxesControl_Unloaded\(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e\)`n        {`n            // Unsubscribe from the AxisControl to prevent memory leaks`n            if \(_subscribedAxisControl != null\)`n            {`n                _subscribedAxisControl.PlotChanged -= AxisPropertiesControl_PlotChanged;`n                _subscribedAxisControl = null;`n            }`n        }`n",
    ""\)

# 10. Remove the Unloaded subscription in constructor
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "`n            // Clean up event subscriptions when control is unloaded`n            Unloaded += AxesControl_Unloaded;",
    ""\)

# Clean up empty #region Private Methods / #endregion if left empty
$content = $content.Replace\(
    "        #region Private Methods`n`n        #endregion",
    ""\)

# Clean up multiple consecutive blank lines \(more than 2\)
while \($content.Contains\("`n`n`n"\)\) {
    $content = $content.Replace\("`n`n`n", "`n`n"\)
}

# Convert back to CRLF
$content = $content -replace "\(?<!\\r\)\\n", "`r`n"

[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText\($file, $content\)
Write-Host "Done fixing AxesControl.xaml.cs"
PSEOF)
